title: Don’t miss this tour
text: Take this tour! Juanmi was an excellent guide and an incredible historian. He made the city come alive with the information and stories he shared. It was a good size group, so we were all able to stay together. It’s very flat and a relatively slow pace. Just make sure you have ridden a bike in the last year or so, as you do ride through some busy streets via the bike path. The staff at Check-in is super friendly too. Don’t miss this bike tour.
author: B918OKlindad

title: Great informative tour
text: Daniel was a very informative tour guide who made the tour fun. It was very easy cycling on the flat and the whole experience gave us a really good feel for the city. I would highly recommend it.
author: Angela_S

title: Fantastic bike tour with Daniel! ★★★★★
text:
We had a brilliant morning with SeeByBike, guided by Daniel, who was entertaining, knowledgeable, and great fun throughout. He clearly knew his history and brought the city to life as we rode.

The route was lovely and scenic, following the river and then into the beautiful gardens and old town, it was flat, so genuinely easy for riders of any level. The bikes themselves were in great condition — comfortable, easy to handle, with good brakes — which made the whole experience feel safe and relaxed from start to finish.

A really enjoyable, low-effort way to get oriented in Seville. Highly recom
author: SimonHarrogate

title: Daniel was great! Got to...
text: Daniel was great! Got to see a lot of different places along the river and in the city. Also got a lot of great recommendations to go to eat and drink after the tour. Highly recommend!
author: Brandon_R

title: Great tour guide, many stops, well done Ivan!
text: This was an excellent tour on bike, not too strenuous, but a small to moderate amount of exercise. We saw some of the best sites in Seville with our incredible Tour Guide Ivan, who was born and raised here.
author: Ira_P

title: Would highly recommend
text: Everyone had a great time on the tour with Daniel. A good mix of history, interesting information and time to explore…. Would highly recommend
author: Lee_C

title: Ask for Daniel.
text: Spent the tour with DANIEL. He was great, very knowledgeable and had a great sense of humor. Would definitely want to ride with him again.

title: Daniel was amazing. Loved...
text:
Daniel was amazing. Loved the story telling and very accommodating. I forgot to bring a jacket and it stated pouring so he gave me his jacket. 

It’s a very well organised tour and the staff very efficient and friendly.
author: Mona_J

title: Ivan was fantastic and bikes were so fun!
text: Great experience with Ivan! Bikes were easy to get used to and Ivan, who is now in university for history showed his love for his hometown of Seville. Would recommend to anyone who can ride a bike!
author: Wren_W

title: Great tour and guide
text: A fun and interesting way to see the sights. Great value for money and lots of good advice about what to see and do after the bike tour.
